_notes: Runtime profile lives at ~/.mrweirdo-jobs/profile.json after /mrweirdo-onboard runs.
profile.json is local user state. Never commit a real profile.
Field names match what real Greenhouse + Ashby forms expect.
Leave a field as the placeholder if you do not want the skill to touch it.

education._gpa_notes: gpa ships EMPTY on purpose, same as work_authorization and the relocation keys. A factory number is byte-for-byte what a real answer looks like, so nothing downstream can tell 'the user told us his GPA' from 'the factory guessed one' — apply_gap_report.mjs:266 reads any truthy value as 'the profile knows this', so a template GPA is never questioned and gets typed onto real forms. Empty means nobody said: the driver blocks the field and the report asks (category user_gpa).

work_authorization._notes: Ships EMPTY on purpose, same as legal_attestations and demographics. A pre-filled `true` here is byte-for-byte identical to a real answer, so no code downstream could tell 'the user told us' from 'the factory guessed'. These are three-state: true / false / null meaning never asked. Onboarding question A0 fills them via shared/record_profile_answers.mjs; while authorized_to_work_us or requires_sponsorship_future is null, a real batch refuses to start and asks instead of guessing.

legal_attestations._notes: Optional. Leave null unless the user explicitly confirms. The auto-apply driver will skip legally sensitive questions instead of guessing.

demographics._notes: Ships EMPTY on purpose. Voluntary EEO self-disclosure is the user's to answer; a pre-filled value is indistinguishable from a real answer in code. Leave null unless the user explicitly states it — the drivers decline to answer these questions by default.

standard_qa.why_company: Short default answer about why you want to work here. The skill may overwrite this per company.
standard_qa.why_role: Short default answer about why this role fits you.
standard_qa._relocation_notes: Ships EMPTY on purpose, same as work_authorization. Agreeing to move to an employer's city is a promise about the user's life, and a factory `true` here is byte-for-byte identical to a real answer — with it set, a brand-new install answered 'Yes' to 'Would you be willing to relocate to our New York office?' for a user who was never asked. Onboarding fills these from the user's own words; until then the driver surfaces the question instead of guessing.
standard_qa.preferred_work_arrangement: Open to onsite, hybrid, or remote

_notes: 用于 mrweirdo-jobs sourcing + AI matching。
role_types mirrors search_intent.role_type_targets after onboarding; leave empty in the template.
role_types 决定 AI 接受什么类型的岗位；不在列表里的 role 会被 AI 自动 fit_score ≤ 3。
exclude_keywords：JD 或 title 含任何这些词，会触发 hard exclusion (fit_score -5)。必须按用户目标职能生成；模板不预设任何职能排除。

relocation_policy 出厂留空：它是 apply 驱动读取搬迁意愿的第二个来源（greenhouse_apply_driver.mjs:308 的 target_filters 回退），预填 anywhere_primary_country 会让新用户在「你愿意搬到纽约吗」这类题上被自动答 Yes。引导阶段按用户原话写入 search_intent.geographic_preference.relocation_policy。
target_filters._batch_pace_options: fast | normal | slow | stealth — see mrweirdo-jobs SKILL.md for per-pace timing. Default 'slow' for human-pacing.
target_filters._max_auto_apply_per_run_notes: Optional cap. Leave unset to process all currently eligible queued rows; set MRWEIRDO_MAX_AUTO_APPLY only when the user asks to limit a run.

greenhouse._notes: Greenhouse-specific tweaks. The country picker uses 'United States +1' with the space-+1 suffix.

ashby._notes: Ashby _systemfield_name is a single combined field, not first/last.
